heavy.selection: Maximum original >=80% training-airing count within the fixed primary validation cohort: 1,845 watches across 408 programmes. This is the unique maximum. The same earlier example is retained, independently of predictions or AP.
heavy.summary: The heavy viewer's validation favourites are mainstream news plus SpongeBob and Breakfast with 1+1. Popularity happens to recover the complete five-ID set. Personalisation is useful on average but is not the winner for this individual.
heavy.short_comment: Popularity recovers all five favourites (AP=1.00). CBF over-concentrates on news (3/5), while rules/PPR recover four favourites but omit SpongeBob. MF recovers the cartoon but promotes the historical Peppa preference, which falls to six validation watches. The hybrid combines the main news favourites with SpongeBob (4/5, AP=0.80). Its last-slot Vikna prediction is watched 15 times, exactly tied with the included Breakfast target; that single set miss depends on the documented numeric-ID tie-break. This is a useful boundary case where the cohort-best hybrid does not beat popularity.

methods.popularity: 5/5 hits, AP@5=1.0000. All five global favourites are also this viewer's local true Top-5; their internal frequency order is irrelevant when every recommendation is relevant.
methods.cbf: 3/5 hits, AP@5=0.5200. The count-weighted content profile returns five news programmes, recovering TSN, Fakty and Segodnya but missing the cartoon and breakfast show. Dengi has only one qualifying validation watch; semantic similarity does not identify the user's frequency favourites precisely.
methods.association_rules: 4/5 hits, AP@5=0.7600. Weekly co-view links recover the news/breakfast cluster but allocate two slots to the programmes tied at 15 watches and omit SpongeBob, which has 22. The saved antecedent contributions show the matched rules supporting these scores.
methods.mf: 4/5 hits, AP@5=0.8000. MF retains the major news programmes and SpongeBob, but promotes Peppa Pig instead of Breakfast. Peppa had 93 strict training watches but only six qualifying validation watches, consistent with a historical favourite becoming less prominent.
methods.ppr: 4/5 hits, AP@5=0.7600. The personalized co-view graph returns the same news/breakfast IDs as rules here. It misses the 22-watch SpongeBob target while retaining Vikna, whose 15 watches tie the fifth-place threshold.
methods.hybrid_007: 4/5 hits, AP@5=0.8000. MF/popularity support brings SpongeBob into the list, while PPR/rules agreement retains Vikna in the last slot. This replaces the MF-only Peppa recommendation. Its single set miss is sensitive to the fifth-place tie described below.

heavy.limitation: Breakfast (ID 20088) and Vikna (ID 2400467) each have 15 qualifying validation watches. The frozen local numeric-ID tie-break includes Breakfast and excludes Vikna. Vikna is therefore a metric miss, despite equal observed frequency; it is not evidence that the viewer disliked or did not watch it. Peppa and Dengi were also watched, but fall outside the true Top-5.

light.selection: Minimum nonzero original >=80% training-airing count within the fixed primary validation cohort: one watch of one programme. Eighteen users tie at one; ascending decimal user-ID string selects this user. At >=50% this viewer has 14 qualifying airings across five programmes, so the viewer is warm and has useful partial evidence.
light.summary: The only strict training programme is Dom na zavist vsem (entertainment). Validation contains eight qualifying watches of five programmes: Segodnya, TSN, Fakty, The Bachelor and Kitchen. All five are new under the strict-80% definition, although several have partial prior exposure. No method recovers Kitchen in these lists.
light.short_comment: With only one strict training watch, CBF stays in entertainment and gets no Top-5 hit. Popularity and rules recover three news targets. The softer collaborative history retains nine partial Bachelor watches, helping MF (2/5) and PPR (3/5); PPR and popularity have equal AP=0.52 but different hit sets. The final hybrid gets Bachelor, Segodnya and TSN (3/5, AP=0.4833), yet reinforces the shared partial-only Vikna error and retains an MF-only MasterChef candidate instead of the true Fakty target. Kitchen is missed by every method. This illustrates sparse qualifying history and the limits of fusion, not a universal preference for popularity.

methods.popularity: 3/5 hits, AP@5=0.5200. Global news favourites recover Segodnya, TSN and Fakty even with little strict personal history. SpongeBob has no observed validation overlap; Breakfast has only partial overlap and no qualifying watch.
methods.cbf: 0/5 hits, AP@5=0.0000. Its strict-count profile is anchored entirely to Dom na zavist vsem, so all five outputs are entertainment. None enters the qualifying validation Top-5; Menyayu zhenu and Khata na tata do have partial overlaps, so these are not claims of no viewing or dislike.
methods.association_rules: 3/5 hits, AP@5=0.4833. Rules transfer from the one strict antecedent to three correct news targets. For example, Dom na zavist vsem -> TSN has training weekly-basket confidence 0.673. Breakfast and ChistoNews still receive slots without qualifying validation watches.
methods.mf: 2/5 hits, AP@5=0.2333. Softer training preserves nine 50%-qualified Bachelor airings, and MF correctly recommends The Bachelor and Segodnya. It ranks Vikna first even though validation has only partial overlaps, and its MasterChef/series candidates do not become true Top-5 programmes.
methods.ppr: 3/5 hits, AP@5=0.5200. The Bachelor receives 44.2% of the training restart mass and is correctly ranked first; Segodnya and TSN also hit. Vikna and the old strict favourite Dom na zavist vsem consume two slots without a qualifying validation watch. This hit set differs from popularity despite identical AP.
methods.hybrid_007: 3/5 hits, AP@5=0.4833. It combines Bachelor, Segodnya and TSN, but MF/PPR agreement reinforces the partial-only Vikna prediction. The MF-only MasterChef rank-four vote contributes 0.125, exceeding Fakty's combined rules/popularity contribution 0.09375, so the true Fakty target is missed.

light.limitation: MasterChef ties Dom na zavist vsem at RRF utility 0.125; the fixed training-popularity tie-break selects MasterChef. Light is defined by strict qualifying counts, not total logged activity: this user has many short overlaps. The example demonstrates threshold sensitivity and sparse-history uncertainty rather than proving that global popularity is always preferable.
